implementation_priority: immediate — exit timing is the dominant failure driver (Phase 6: avg_giveback=122.8%)

ranked_strategies.description: ATR Trailing Stop (2.5× ATR) — widest ATR trail; stays in longer trending moves
ranked_strategies.implementation_notes: Widest ATR trail. Use when trend_strength is high and holding a runner.
ranked_strategies.risk: Wider stop preserves trend trades but accepts larger drawdowns.

ranked_strategies.description: Time Exit (10 bars) — close trade at bar 10; gives more room before max Phase 5 window
ranked_strategies.implementation_notes: Hard close at bar 10. Last time-based option before Phase 5 max window.
ranked_strategies.risk: Same as time_8bars; closest to current Phase 5 behavior.

ranked_strategies.description: Volatility-Adaptive Trail — trailing stop distance = 2.0× ATR × max(1, current_vol / entry_vol); expands in high-vol bars
ranked_strategies.implementation_notes: Compute vol_ratio = current_vol / entry_vol. mult = base_mult * clip(vol_ratio, 0.5, 3.0). Higher volatility → wider stop. Prevents whipsawing in news events.
ranked_strategies.risk: Vol ratio can spike in news events, making stop extremely wide. Apply max vol_ratio cap.

ranked_strategies.description: Time Exit (8 bars) — close trade at bar 8; balances time-in-trade with trend capture
ranked_strategies.implementation_notes: Hard close at bar 8. Optimal time boundary based on simulation.
ranked_strategies.risk: Same as time_6bars; slightly more room.

ranked_strategies.description: ATR Trailing Stop (2.0× ATR) — stop trails by 2.0 × ATR; wider room for price to breathe
ranked_strategies.implementation_notes: Same as atr_trail_1.5 with multiplier 2.0. Allow more room in volatile conditions.
ranked_strategies.risk: Balanced; main risk is holding through reversals in low-ADX conditions.

ranked_strategies.description: Time Exit (6 bars) — close the trade at bar 6 at the close price; no further signal needed
ranked_strategies.implementation_notes: Hard close at bar 6 regardless of PnL. Simplest possible time exit. Set a timer in the execution engine.
ranked_strategies.risk: Hard stop ignores market conditions; may exit winning trades prematurely.

ranked_strategies.description: VWAP Cross Exit — exit when price moves to the wrong side of VWAP
ranked_strategies.implementation_notes: Exit CE when price falls below VWAP (price_vs_vwap < 0). Exit PE when price rises above VWAP. VWAP is session-level and always current.
ranked_strategies.risk: VWAP resets daily; near session open, VWAP may not be meaningful.

ranked_strategies.description: Partial Profit + Runner — exit 50% at 15-pt target; trail remaining 50% with 2.0× ATR stop
ranked_strategies.implementation_notes: On first 15pt target touch, close 50% of position. Trail remaining 50% with 2.0*ATR stop. Requires position size management.
ranked_strategies.risk: Requires position size management in execution engine. Risk: complex implementation; slippage on partial exit.

ranked_strategies.description: SuperTrend Exit — exit when the SuperTrend indicator reverses direction against the trade
ranked_strategies.implementation_notes: Monitor supertrend_dir each bar. Exit CE when supertrend_dir <= 0. Exit PE when supertrend_dir >= 0. Simple 1-line check.
ranked_strategies.risk: SuperTrend can lag by 2-4 bars in volatile sessions; risk of giving back gains.

ranked_strategies.description: EMA20 Cross Exit — exit when close crosses EMA20 against trade direction
ranked_strategies.implementation_notes: Exit CE when close < EMA20. Exit PE when close > EMA20. Standard trend-following filter.
ranked_strategies.risk: EMA is a lagging indicator; will give back some profit before triggering.

ranked_strategies.description: Momentum Exhaustion Exit — exit when momentum_velocity reverses sign after trade is in profit, or when RSI reaches extreme (>72 CE / <28 PE)
ranked_strategies.implementation_notes: Monitor momentum_velocity for sign reversal after trade is profitable. Also check RSI: exit CE if RSI > 72, exit PE if RSI < 28. Early momentum-based exit.
ranked_strategies.risk: Momentum_velocity can oscillate; risk of false exit signals in healthy trending bars.

ranked_strategies.description: ATR Trailing Stop (1.5× ATR) — stop trails below/above close by 1.5 × ATR; only moves in trade direction
ranked_strategies.implementation_notes: Set stop = entry - 1.5*ATR on entry. On each new bar, raise stop if close - 1.5*ATR > current stop. Exit if low <= stop.
ranked_strategies.risk: Tight stop may exit prematurely in choppy bars. Risk: reduced win rate if trend continues after stop.

ranked_strategies.description: Chandelier Exit (1.5× ATR, 10-bar) — wider chandelier; allows more volatility
ranked_strategies.implementation_notes: Same as chandelier_1.0 with 1.5x ATR. Allows more swing room.
ranked_strategies.risk: Same as chandelier_1.0 but accepts more giveback; risk of large losses in sharp reversals.

ranked_strategies.description: Break-even + Trail (1.5× ATR) — break-even at +8 pts; trail by 1.5× ATR; tighter than 2.0× for faster profit protection
ranked_strategies.implementation_notes: Same as be_trail_1.0 with wider 1.5x trail. More room for trend to develop after locking break-even.
ranked_strategies.risk: Same risk as be_trail_1.0; once BE is active, the trail is wider.

ranked_strategies.description: Break-even + Trail (1.0× ATR) — once trade is +8 pts profitable, lock break-even stop; then trail by 1.0× ATR
ranked_strategies.implementation_notes: Phase 1: hold with wide stop. Phase 2: once unrealized >= 8pts, move stop to entry (break-even). Phase 3: trail by 1.0*ATR from peak. Requires trade state tracking.
ranked_strategies.risk: If trade never reaches BE trigger (8 pts), initial stop is wider. Risk: full-size loss on trades that retrace immediately.

ranked_strategies.description: Chandelier Exit (1.0× ATR, 10-bar) — stop = rolling_max_high(10) − 1.0 × ATR; classic institutional exit
ranked_strategies.implementation_notes: stop_ce = max(highs_since_entry) - 1.0*ATR. Update rolling max on each bar. Widely used by institutional traders.
ranked_strategies.risk: Chandelier anchors to prior high; may lag in fast reversals.
